item.title: Member-to-Member knowledge sharing elevating skills excellence in Ghana
item.description: A long-standing mentoring partnership between WorldSkills Germany and WorldSkills Ghana is deepening Expert capacity, strengthening national training systems, and helping Ghana step confidently onto the global stage for skills.

item.title: UNIDO to host WorldSkills Conference Coalition and hybrid event on demand-driven skills development
item.description: UNIDO welcomes the WorldSkills community to register for the event ‘Demand-Driven Skills for Youth Empowerment and Industrial Transformation’ on 3 March.

item.title: Applications open for BeChangeMaker 2026, celebrating a decade of social entrepreneurship
item.description: Apply now to be part of the 10th edition of the programme that has empowered hundreds of young innovators worldwide.

item.title: WorldSkills community prepares for WorldSkills Conference 2026
item.description: Inspired by their experience at Lyon, WorldSkills Members have begun securing their spot at WorldSkills Conference 2026 alongside global thought leaders and TVET systems-shapers.

item.title: WorldSkills celebrates International Women’s Day 2026
item.description: On International Women’s Day 2026, the WorldSkills community is encouraged to reflect on the different ways it can “give” to help the next generation of women “gain”.

item.title: Global skills leaders meet in Vienna to shape WorldSkills Conference 2026
item.description: UNIDO hosted the WorldSkills Conference Coalition and engaged its members in the event “Demand-Driven Skills for Youth Empowerment and Industrial Transformation”.

item.title: Join the WorldSkills Conference 2026: A Global Skills Hub
item.description: Join global leaders at WorldSkills Conference 2026 in Shanghai, September 23-25, to shape the future of TVET and skills innovation.

item.title: WorldSkills Lyon 2024 drives skills transformation across France
item.description: WorldSkills France continues to celebrate the impact of WorldSkills Lyon 2024 and show how it has encouraged greater support for skills and continued success at a national and international level.

item.title: Nigeria reinforces its ongoing commitment to TVET
item.description: Nigeria’s federal government has officially inaugurated the WorldSkills Nigeria Committee, marking a significant step in the country’s commitment to strengthening skills-based education and elevating the status of skills.

item.title: WorldSkills Museum and Neusoft launch new drone exhibition
item.description: Visitors to the world’s only museum dedicated to skills can now experience what it feels like to be a drone pilot and test their navigation skills on real-world scenarios.
